main.summary: Create, serialize, and parse signed common-identification artifacts.

item.description: [..] : Optional ExpiresAtUnix (Int64, big-endian, seconds when present)
The signature target is the canonical common-identification data bytes only.
Verification requires the resolved signer certificate thumbprint to match the data thumbprint exactly.
`NotBefore` is mandatory. `ExpiresAt` is optional and, when absent, the artifact has no expiration boundary.

field.name: SignatureAlgorithmRsaSha512Pss
field.summary: Internal signature algorithm discriminator for RSA-PSS SHA-512.

field.name: ByteSize
field.summary: Serialized size of a single byte field.

field.name: GuidSize
field.summary: Serialized size of a Guid value written with .

field.name: Int64Size
field.summary: Serialized size of a 64-bit integer field.

field.name: UInt16Size
field.summary: Serialized size of a 16-bit unsigned integer field.

field.name: UInt32Size
field.summary: Serialized size of a 32-bit unsigned integer field.

method.name: TryCreateArtifact
method.summary: Create a signed artifact from canonical data and an issuer certificate.
method.param: Canonical common-identification data to serialize and sign.
Issuer certificate containing the RSA private key used to sign the canonical data. The certificate thumbprint must match exactly.
method.returns: True when the data was valid and the signed artifact was created successfully; otherwise false.

method.name: TryCreateBytes
method.summary: Create serialized signed common-identification bytes from canonical data and an issuer certificate.
method.param: Canonical common-identification data to serialize and sign.
Issuer certificate containing the RSA private key used to sign the canonical data.
method.returns: True when the artifact was created and serialized successfully; otherwise false.

method.name: TryReadArtifact
method.summary: Read serialized signed common-identification bytes into a parsed artifact without performing trust or time validation.
method.returns: True when the envelope and canonical data were parsed successfully; otherwise false.

method.name: TryReadParts
method.summary: Read serialized signed common-identification bytes into canonical data and signature parts.
method.returns: True when the envelope and canonical data were parsed successfully; otherwise false.

method.name: BuildEnvelope
method.summary: Build the signed binary envelope for a parsed common-identification artifact.

method.name: TryReadEnvelope
method.summary: Read the outer signed envelope into canonical data and signature byte segments.
method.returns: True when the envelope structure was well formed; otherwise false.

method.name: TryReadData
method.summary: Parse canonical data bytes into a structured instance.
method.returns: True when the canonical data parsed and passed invariant validation; otherwise false.

method.name: TryWriteData
method.summary: Serialize canonical common-identification data into its fixed binary layout.
method.returns: True when serialization succeeded; otherwise false.

method.name: TryReadOptionalDateTimeOffset
method.summary: Read an optional Unix-seconds DateTimeOffset field from the canonical binary layout.
method.param: Reference reader positioned on the optional date value.
True when the optional value is present in the payload.
method.returns: True when parsing succeeded; otherwise false.

method.name: TryReadOptionalGuid
method.summary: Read an optional Guid field from the canonical binary layout.
method.param: Reference reader positioned on the optional Guid value.
True when the optional Guid is present in the payload.
method.returns: True when parsing succeeded; otherwise false.

method.name: TryReadUtf8String
method.summary: Read a length-prefixed UTF-8 string field from the canonical binary layout.
method.param: Reference reader positioned on the string field.
method.returns: True when parsing and UTF-8 decoding succeeded; otherwise false.
